findings.summary: deploy_probe_service.py --dry-run performs live describe_services/describe_task_definition read calls before the dry-run branch, unlike the plan's no-creds fallback. Read-only, no mutation, no secret printed. Optional: guard the describes behind a credentials check so dry-run is fully offline.

The dry-run image URI embeds the mirrored EXPECTED_ACCOUNT constant. Sanctioned by the plan as a source-cited mirror (not a new hard-coded id); the real run derives the account from STS and asserts it. No action required.

deploy_probe_image.py wraps ECR repo tag_resource in a broad except that only warns, so a missing ecr:TagResource permission fails silently. Acceptable since push must not depend on tagging; list ecr:TagResource in the hand-off IAM notes.
